visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a high-angle view looking down into an open-top double-decker tour bus. Over twenty young women wearing white and black Rakuten baseball-style jerseys and short black skirts are densely packed into the seating area. They are all standing or seated, rhythmically swaying and pumping their arms in a synchronized dance. One woman in the lower-right foreground holds a white smartphone with both hands, recording herself as she smiles broadly and dances. The bus features bright red seats and a dark wooden-textured floor, while the surrounding environment shows passing green trees and a grey asphalt road surface. (2) As the bus continues to travel, the group's movements become more energetic, with many raising their arms high and shouting in unison. A girl in the middle section with a prominent red bow in her hair leads part of the movement with expansive gestures. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating daytime, although the sky is likely overcast as there are no harsh shadows. The overall scene is vibrant, filled with consistent physical activity and facial expressions of joy and excitement from the various cheerleaders in the frame.

The vocal intensity is high, with sharp transients from percussive 'hey' shouts that occur on the main beats of the music.
